name: Fengpei (Fiona) Yuan
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Strong recent-AP technical HRI match, combining learned perception and language interaction with a currently directed physical robot system. Computational prototyping is relevant; any access to clinical studies requires separate approval.

physicalEvidence.summary: Current-group Pepper study integrates YOLOv11 object detection with physical head/arm pointing, GPT-4o/Whisper dialogue and classical ROS waypoint navigation. Full 2025 methods document a 12-person healthy-adult laboratory pilot with empty bottles; official 2026 conference abstract reports an expanded 24-person study. Gaze was logged rather than used for live adaptation. This is a research prototype, not validated dementia treatment. In the 2025 protocol, tablet buttons initiate navigation and push-to-talk, and participants confirm completion; no automatic medication-intake verification is demonstrated.

shortVisit.summary: Published research survey is specifically for WPI students. A separate outside-WPI collaboration paragraph is not an explicit visitor/intern invitation. External-master appointment, duration, Summer 2027 capacity, remote participation and funding remain unknown.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct multimodal AI/social-robot research with an independent current lab and relevant computational methods.

scoreReasons.shortVisit: No explicit outside-student visit route, only local intake and general collaboration.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current 2026 conference program and lab bibliography establish recent research beyond appointment publicity.
